held_back_by.text: Modal reports no per-sandbox cost or usage.

exclusions: Network egress (new): from 2026-10-01 outbound traffic is $0.04 per GiB above a workspace-wide allowance of 1 TiB per billing cycle on Starter, 10 TiB on Team, 100 TiB on Enterprise; it counts container-to-container traffic and Cloud Bucket Mount uploads, not Volume reads and writes. Tracked from 2026-09-01 with no charge in September; the first bill with egress is 2026-11-01. The benchmarks send almost nothing, so this is $0 per hour at these sizes under any plan.
Per-creation fee: none listed on the pricing page or the Sandbox docs
Volumes: $0.09 / GiB / month, first 1 TiB / month free (not used by the benchmarks)
Sandbox filesystem and memory snapshots: retained 30 and 7 days; no price stated (not used)
Plan fee: Starter $0 / month + compute; Team $250 / month + compute. The sandbox rates are the same on both.

Plan allowance: Starter: $0 / month plus compute, with $30 / month free credits, 100 containers and 3 seats; Team $250 / month with $100 / month free credits and 5000 containers; credit programs for startups and academics up to $10k (by application)
